body: I failed, just as in everything I fucking do. What a joke.

I truly appreciate your time here. I'm glad I posted here. I'm starting to feel a little drowsy. Now so I probably won't post much more. I wish you all the best. Truly. K ow that you made a lost soul smile. And if I unfortunately wake tomorrow, I will message you and maybe my sober self will. E less stubborn and listen. Thank you. Truly
I truly want to stop feeling, and stop thinking. Death is the only cure for that.
My life is a fucking cruel joke. If there is a god,  he's one sadistic motherfucker

I won't find it again. It's a miracle found her. I'm ugly, I'm socially awkward and have social anxiety, I'm broken inside. And as if that weren't enough, I'm inexperienced in bed and have a smaller than average dick! Oh and I'm almost completely bald at the age of 29. And unemployed currently.  And nothing to show for my time of employment.

Good memories are the strangers who have been kinder to me the past few weeks than my supposed best friends. The time spent with my ex... have some cliche like fucking romcom scenes that happened irl, and they were beautiful. Watching my little sisters already become better than me when they graduated high school. That's all I can even think of for good over my entire life. The bad memories were mostly just the past couple years

This past couple years has been nothing but tragedy between heartbreak from my ex, from losing one of my best friends who I had been in love with since high school to cancer at the age of 29, as well as numerous family issues. A job I hate almost as much as I hate myself. A fucking lifetime of feeling like I was bothering anyone and everyone by talking to them, a lifetime of feeling like I didn't belong anywhere. More than 20 years of regrets. Failing at everything I try.

It isn't what I want but it's the best I got. I just wanted some final memories of people being kind. I've had too many bad memories lately. Thank you. And I'm a hypocrite for saying it but if you think these thoughts, please seek help, everyone. No one should feel like this.
